subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The decision to go on a trip after my vacations was the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"icing on the cake"** means something **that makes a good situation even better.** (किसी अच्छी स्थिति को और भी बेहतर बनाने वाली चीज़)

 
 
• **Example: **Winning the lottery was amazing, but getting a new car as well was just the icing on the cake.
 
 
 
• **"Icing on the cake"** refers to an additional benefit or positive aspect that enhances an already good situation. (किसी अच्छी स्थिति में और अधिक लाभ जोड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The bonus at the end of the year was the icing on the cake for all the hard work we put in.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:** icing on the cake.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ice on the cake **(केक पर बर्फ): This is not a commonly used idiom and does not convey the intended meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Apple on the cake **(केक पर सेब): This is not a commonly used idiom and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Icing on the brownie **(ब्राउनी पर आइसिंग): This is not a commonly used idiom and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 

3d:Tccc,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
